blurb: Guests can join SUP or kayak tours and lessons suitable for beginners through advanced paddlers, with locations chosen based on ability, weather, and proximity. They also offer fat bike tours on the largest tidal flat in North America and a family-friendly pirate adventure paddle with water cannon battles. Rentals and tours are delivered or meet at calm local launch sites across Upper and Mid Cape Cod.

quotes.text: What a great lesson with Amy! She got me up and paddling on a beautiful pond with turtles and lily pads at one end, Amy is also a physical therapist and she was able to provide me with critical information on how to align and adjust my body, especially since I’ve had a past ankle injury. I was very shaky at the beginning, but felt so much more confident by the end of the lesson. I highly recommend Amy and Peace love, SUP and hope to join her on the water again - Google Reviews, July 2025

Amy was a wonderful guide & made us super comfortable as first-time paddle boarders. So kind & patient, and she showed us a fantastic swimming spot to cool off mid paddle. We had a terrific time. - Google Reviews, July 2025
